About Me

PRENGINEERING WITH CURIOSITY

Hi, I’m Prashanth.

I am Prashanth Reddy Erangari, a Software Development Engineer with a B.Tech in Information Technology from IIIT Vadodara. I enjoy turning ideas into working products through frontend engineering, full-stack development, application workflows, API integration, and practical problem-solving.

My super powers

Application development · Requirements gathering · Workflow design · API integration · Testing & debugging · Team collaboration

My roots & foundation

B.Tech in Information Technology at IIIT Vadodara, 2022–2026. A foundation in software engineering and practical problem-solving.

What I do

At Anytime Diesel, I work across application development, operational workflows, reports, testing, debugging and coordination with internal and external teams.

The future of tech

I am interested in scalable applications, AI, computer vision and thoughtful product engineering that solves meaningful problems.
